title.from: Spike: home-page language redirect and hreflang on a preview stack
title.to: Spike: countdown banner and hreflang prototype in preview

description.from: Prototype the viewer-request branch for '/' in amplify/publication/redirect-and-index.js: explicit choice by '?lang=xx' sets the papyrus_lang cookie and redirects to the clean URL; cookie next; then Accept-Language matched to public languages; no header or no match means no redirect. Redirects are 302 with Cache-Control private, no-store and Vary Accept-Language, Cookie; page cache keys unchanged. Test with CloudFront function test tooling and a preview stack deployed through the pipeline (nothing by hand). Validate hreflang and x-default output with a search engine's testing tools. Plan: docs/plans/multilingual-publishing.md (PR #1450).
description.to: The edge redirect is removed from the design (Ryan's decision 6). Prototype the client-side countdown banner and hreflang output on tools/preview_production.py: matching navigator.languages to page alternates (zh-CN/zh-SG to zh-Hans), the remembered reading language, location.replace and Back, pause on scroll, aria-live, reduced motion, and the 'never toward the primary' rule. Check with a search engine's URL inspection that a translated page is rendered without redirecting. Not started: the coordinator asked to hold anything needing a deployed preview stack. Plan: docs/plans/multilingual-publishing.md (PR #1450), revised 2026-11-12 with Ryan's decisions.
